issue.title: [Bug]: edit with replace_all corrupts literal dollar sequences in replacement text

steps: Create a file named example.txt in the current workspace whose content is exactly two lines: `before TOKEN after` and `TOKEN`, each ending with a newline.
In example.txt, replace all occurrences of TOKEN with the literal text $$ using the edit tool with replace_all.
expected: Every TOKEN is replaced by the literal text `$$`, so example.txt becomes `before $$ after\n$$\n`.
defect: The edit tool reports success but the file becomes `before $ after\n$\n`, because `$$` in new_string is interpreted as a JavaScript replacement pattern.

fault location.explanation: Calls haystack.replaceAll(needle, replacement) with the model's new_string as a replacement string, so `$$`, `$&`, `$'` and `$`` are expanded as special patterns; PR #165 (commit f3160cd) passes a callback `() => replacement` so the text is inserted literally.

Builds the full-file replace_all edit by calling rawStringReplaceAll(rawContent, oldString, newString), feeding the unescaped new_string into the faulty replacement; this call site is unchanged by the fix but is the path the replace_all edit takes.

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/minimax-code/pull/165 (commit f3160cdb224a126576e4403d022b5d17c7558770). When the edit tool is called with replace_all: true, LocalEditTool delegates to buildReplaceAllEdit, which counts occurrences and then rewrites the whole file with rawStringReplaceAll(rawContent, oldString, newString). That helper uses String.prototype.replaceAll with new_string as a replacement string, and JavaScript expands `$$` to `$`, `$&` to the match, and `$'`/`$`` to the text after/before the match, so the written file differs from what the model asked for while the tool still reports success (and `$&` yields a false 'No changes made'). The fix passes a replacer callback `() => replacement`, which makes the replacement literal. The fix (2026-09-19) is first contained in release v0.5.0; the ABB-pinned revision a5639bcc (also package version 0.4.12) already contains it, so the case is tested at the issue's stated source commit 17b8ded9 (0.4.12), where the faulty line 96 is present.
